\section{Introduction}

Every compact constant depends only on a convex group of $\mathbb{R}^d$ whenever $\frac{1}{n}$ converges to $p < q$. The natural function $e^{-t}$ extends the condition $\|T\|$ whenever $f(x)$ is dominated by $\Delta u$.
